title: Seismicity map of south-central South Carolina, May 1974 - December, 1977 with cross section showing depth distribution of hypocenters projected into plane A-A'
citation: Cook, R.D., Carver, David, and Dart, Richard, 1978, Seismicity map of south-central South Carolina, May 1974 - December, 1977 with cross section showing depth distribution of hypocenters projected into plane A-A': U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-78-353, map scale 1:250,000.
notes:
Single OCR sheet: seismicity map (earthquake epicenters, May 1974 - December 1977) with a hypocenter-depth cross section; not a geologic map. The OCR is nearly all noise: only fragments of the explanation (earthquake epicenters, size varies according to magnitude; site information of seismograph stations in south-central South Carolina) and garbled station names and dates (e.g. 'Rowman', 'Caweew Swanp', 'Caw Castle Cr.', 'Hares Bluff'; '5/20/14', '10/23/77') are legible. No values could be recorded reliably, so the result is empty.
SUBSURFACE: the cross section A-A' of hypocenter depths named in the catalog title is not legible in the OCR (page 1); no epicenter coordinates, depths or magnitudes readable.
